title: Renewal Terms of the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy
content:
Renewal of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy rolls the policy into a new twelve-month term.

## Clauses retired

The following clauses of this rule are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:

- "when the renewal is offered, the tier's renewal offer lead time before expiration";
- "the rating system's indicated premium for the upcoming term is recorded as the indicated renewal premium";
- "and renewal installment 1 is billed on the capped premium";
- "the renewal term premium is the smaller of the indicated renewal premium and the expiring term premium increased by the renewal rate cap, rounded half-up to the cent; the cap never lowers a premium below the indicated amount when the indicated amount is itself lower".

## Clauses in force

1. At renewal, Coverage A is increased by the tier's inflation guard percentage, rounded up to the next 1,000 USD, and capped at the tier's highest Coverage A.
2. At renewal, the roof settlement basis is re-evaluated on the roof age at the new effective date.
3. The policy renews for twelve calendar months when renewal installment 1 is paid by the expiration date; otherwise it expires with the reason "renewal not paid".

## Per-tier renewal values

| Tier | Renewal rate cap (percent) | Inflation guard (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic | 25 | 0 |
| LandlordGuard DP-2 Broad | 20 | 4 |
| LandlordGuard DP-3 Special | 15 | 4 |
| LandlordGuard DP-3 Special Plus | 15 | 4 |
| LandlordGuard DP-3 Premier | 12 | 5 |
| LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio | 10 | 5 |

## Worked Coverage A examples (hypothetical limits)

| Tier | Expiring Coverage A | Increased by the inflation guard | Rounded up to the next 1,000 USD | After the tier's highest Coverage A |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DP-2 Broad (4 percent, highest 400,000) | 287,000 | 298,480 | 299,000 | 299,000 |
| DP-2 Broad (4 percent, highest 400,000) | 390,000 | 405,600 | 406,000 | 400,000 |

## Renewal or expiry

| Renewal installment 1 | Result on the expiration date |
|---|---|
| paid by the expiration date | the policy renews for twelve calendar months |
| not paid by the expiration date | the policy expires, reason "renewal not paid" |
